name: Bamboo Toothbrush
description: A biodegradable toothbrush with a sustainably harvested bamboo handle and BPA-free nylon bristles. Replaces 4 plastic toothbrushes per year.

name: Beeswax Food Wraps
description: Reusable food wraps made from organic cotton infused with beeswax, jojoba oil, and tree resin. A perfect plastic-free alternative to cling film.

name: Recycled Paper Notebook
description: 100% post-consumer recycled paper notebook with a kraft cardboard cover. Acid-free, chlorine-free pages with 80 GSM thickness.

name: Organic Cotton Tote Bag
description: GOTS-certified organic cotton tote bag. Replaces up to 700 single-use plastic bags over its lifetime. Machine washable and durable.

name: Coconut Shell Bowl
description: Handcrafted bowl made from upcycled coconut shells. Each bowl is unique and finished with food-safe natural lacquer. Zero-waste and compostable.

name: Natural Shampoo Bar
description: Sulfate-free, paraben-free solid shampoo bar made with natural plant oils. Equivalent to 2-3 liquid shampoo bottles. Zero plastic packaging.
material: Plant Oils, Essential Oils, Natural Surfactants

name: Recycled Glass Water Bottle
description: 750ml water bottle made from recycled borosilicate glass with a bamboo lid and silicone protective sleeve. BPA-free and dishwasher safe.

name: Hemp Seed Lip Balm
description: 100% natural lip balm made with hemp seed oil, beeswax, and vitamin E. Packaged in a biodegradable paperboard tube. Cruelty-free and vegan.
material: Hemp Seed Oil, Beeswax, Vitamin E

name: Biodegradable Phone Case
description: Phone case made from plant-based bioplastic (PLA + bamboo fiber composite). Fully compostable in industrial composting facilities within 6 months.

name: Compostable Garbage Bags
description: Pack of 30 certified compostable garbage bags (30L) made from cornstarch and vegetable oils. Certified to EN 13432 and ASTM D6400 composting standards.
